props.name: itemId
props.description: Stable key for an entry. Index keys break as soon as the order changes.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: T, state: { index: number; buried: number }) => ReactNode

props.name: top
props.description: Distance from the top of the scroll area each card sticks at, in pixels.

props.name: step
props.description: How far each card below the top of the stack is stepped down, in pixels.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Space each card gets before the next arrives, in pixels.

props.name: scrollRef
props.description: Scroll container. Defaults to the window.
